answer: Bind each agent to a scarce external fact. Require a one-time anchor onto a public blockchain, a signed memo whose fee is paid in real coin, so creating an identity leaves a measurable delta in an outside ledger nobody controls. A lone agent plants one tree; a sybil farm must fund a whole grove of on-chain transactions, each costing gas no faucet refills. The attacker's bill grows with every clone while an honest user pays exactly once.
